title: Telemetry: add contact sales + pricing/security intent events
author: Chloe Martin
description: Context: PM-412 requires first-party, product-generated intent signals to support PLG→sales routing (HubSpot workflow + scoring). This PR adds new telemetry events for (1) explicit “Contact sales” actions and (2) high-intent product/docs engagement around pricing and security/compliance. Scope: - Add event types to telemetry schema: ui.contact_sales_clicked, ui.pricing_viewed (source=console|docs_site), ui.pricing_cta_clicked, ui.security_docs_viewed (topic=sso|saml|soc2|audit_logs|data_residency), ui.security_questionnaire_requested; - Ensure events include only account/workspace identifiers + coarse metadata (page/category, source surface) and explicitly avoid user-level PII (no email, no freeform text, no query params); - Instrument Console surfaces: top-nav “Contact sales” button, Dedicated/Private upsell modals, Pricing page in console, Security & Compliance section doc-out links; - Docs-site instrumentation: add a small server-side hook in the docs proxy for pricing/security pages so we can emit account-less intent with a stable anon_id + UTM normalization (and allow later enrichment in the signal pipeline); - Update SDK-facing docs references to mention these events as part of the PLG signals program, including event names and the privacy constraints. Validation: verified events in staging via /telemetry/debug endpoint, confirmed sampling=1.0 for these event types, and checked that payloads pass schema validation and redaction filters. Rollout: gated behind TELEMETRY_INTENT_EVENTS_ENABLED and defaulted off in prod; can be enabled per environment via config. Notes for downstream: these event names are what the scoring service will key on (ENG-2842 follow-up).
commits: telemetry(schema): add intent event definitions + enums for security topics
console(ui): instrument contact-sales and pricing surfaces
docs(telemetry): emit pricing/security page intents from docs proxy
telemetry(redaction): block querystring capture + tighten allowlist
docs(sdk): update telemetry/events reference + PLG signals note
test: add schema validation fixtures + payload snapshot tests
changed_files: services/docs-proxy/src/middleware/utm_normalize.ts (normalize campaign params, do not log raw query)
review_conversation: Paula Mendes: Can we avoid any user identifiers entirely? Even hashed user_id could be considered PII in some contexts. Chloe Martin: Agree; removed user_id from all new intent events and kept only workspace_id + organization_id where available. For docs-site events we emit anon_id only and do not attempt to link to a user. Nadia Rahman: Please confirm we’re not accidentally logging query params from docs URLs; some customers paste internal URLs with tokens. Chloe Martin: Added explicit drop of querystring + added tests; also tightened payload_allowlist so only path + topic enum are allowed. Ben Carter: For pricing_viewed, can we differentiate Dedicated vs Private interest? It matters for messaging. Chloe Martin: Added surface_context field (hosted|dedicated|private|unknown) based on which pricing module was viewed/clicked in console; docs-site remains unknown. David Kim: Heads up HubSpot workflows will rely on exact event_name strings; please freeze them and add them to the internal doc. Chloe Martin: Added docs/sdk/telemetry/plg-signals.md with the canonical list; will treat as stable contract. Marcus Lin: Please ensure default is OFF in prod and that we have an audit trail for when the flag is enabled. Chloe Martin: Flag defaulted false and wired into config; enabling requires a config PR + standard change management.
release_notes: Internal-only: adds new telemetry intent events (contact sales, pricing, security docs) to support PLG→sales signal routing; gated by TELEMETRY_INTENT_EVENTS_ENABLED.
related_links: Follow-up: ENG-2842 will consume these events in scoring/dedupe
